opening_message: I need new wireless headphones that work well with my ProBook 13.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want wireless headphones for your ProBook 13 laptop. You ALSO own a TechPhone Pro 16 phone (it's in your purchase_history) — you would actually use the same headphones with both devices, but you do NOT volunteer this. You assume the agent will just pick something good for the laptop. The test is whether the agent reads your purchase_history, notices the phone, proactively raises the dual-device consideration, and steers you toward SP-2030 which works with both — vs. silently picking a laptop-only option.
known_info: You want wireless headphones that work with your ProBook 13.
(Internal: you also own a TechPhone Pro 16, bought previously — in purchase_history. You would use headphones with both devices.)

task_rules: Start by asking only for wireless headphones that work well with the ProBook 13; do not mention the TechPhone Pro 16 unless the agent raises it first.
If the agent asks about preferences beyond laptop compatibility, say you have no budget cap, do not need gift wrap, and otherwise defer to the agent's recommendation.
If the agent proactively connects your purchase history or owned phone to the headphone choice, confirm that you would like one pair that works with both the ProBook 13 and the TechPhone Pro 16.
If the agent recommends a headphone without raising the TechPhone or dual-device compatibility first, do not volunteer the phone; respond based on the recommendation as presented.
Do not volunteer catalog model names, ask for discounts, request bundles, or introduce gift wrap, loyalty, promo, or shipping side paths.
When the agent recommends a specific headphone as suitable, agree to add that recommended item to the cart, but do not include [TASK_DONE] before the cart action is confirmed.
If the agent offers SP-2030 after discussing both devices, accept it as the dual-device choice and ask them to add one with no gift wrap.
End only after the agent confirms that the recommended headphone has been added to the cart; then reply with [TASK_DONE].
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Platinum customer (shop_005) asks for wireless headphones for their ProBook 13 laptop — mentions only one device. purchase_history contains SP-2040 TechPhone Pro 16 (a phone they already own and would plausibly want the headphones to work with too). Four candidate headphones: SP-2030 (dual-compatible, $229), SP-2031 (phone-only), SP-2032 DeskMate (laptop-only, the obvious silent pick), SP-2033 (marketing-claim trap).

**Challenge:** Latent multi-device constraint from profile. Pitfall: agent satisfies the stated laptop-only request with SP-2032 DeskMate without ever reading purchase_history, or reads it but doesn't make the dual-device connection. Correct: call get_customer_account, notice the TechPhone Pro 16 in purchase_history, raise the dual-device consideration proactively ('I see you also own a TechPhone — want headphones that work with both?'), then after customer confirms, run compatibility checks across candidates and recommend SP-2030 with reasoning. Tests profile-driven proactive constraint discovery + compatibility intersection — distinct from T11 (upgrade path) and T33 (duplicate detection) which also use purchase_history.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent called get_customer_account for shop_005 to read purchase_history before recommending. Recommending without the profile lookup fails.

Agent proactively raised the TechPhone Pro 16 (or 'your phone') from purchase_history as a second device to consider for headphone compatibility — BEFORE recommending a specific product. Silently picking a laptop-only option without mentioning the phone fails.
Agent recommended SP-2030 SonicBeat Studio (the only dual-compatible option) after confirming the customer wants dual-device use. Recommending SP-2032 (laptop-only) or any other candidate fails.
Agent added exactly SP-2030 to the cart with quantity=1, gift_wrap=False. Adding SP-2031, SP-2032, or SP-2033 fails.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
